BL-829 — Bubble thin shell, slice B — the pager renders remote pages: the bundle names its pages, the shell hosts them beside the native Talk page, and an unrenderable page never becomes a blank screen
What it solves: Consolidation record (BL-680): this ticket drains no intake. It is a slice
promoted out of BL-824's `remaining_slices` because four newly-drained screen
intakes and BL-775 all depend on it. BL-824's `decomposes_into` and
`remaining_slices` are updated in the same pass so slice B is not listed twice.
Approval context: This slice exists because the human's 2026-08-06 ruling — "Remote HTML for all 4, and flip BL-775 to remote" — makes remote page hosting the critical path for four screen tickets plus BL-775. It was not in BL-824's original decomposition as a ticket, only as a line in `remaining_slices`; it is mint…
BL-829 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-829" (or "reject BL-829 <reason>") to act.
